critical_code_review_comments: learn.tsx is now 2190 lines (was 1950 after Phase 4). The new CertificateModal (+cert styles) has pushed it further. Extraction into /components/progression/* is now overdue.

_get_celebrations() writes _prog_seen every call to /hub — including read-only visits — meaning celebrations for xp_gained/level_up/badge_earned are only shown ONCE across all devices/sessions. If the user is on device A when the change occurs and never opens /hub there, device B will overwrite _prog_seen with post-event values and the celebration is lost forever. Consider marking seen only after the client acknowledges the celebration (e.g. POST /progression/celebrations/ack).
CertificateModal.handleShare uses Share.share which throws on web (unsupported). The empty catch hides the failure — user gets no feedback. Add a web fallback (navigator.clipboard.writeText + toast).

Cron endpoint secret defaults to 'mentova-cron-2026' if CRON_SECRET env var is unset — that's a hard-coded fallback in production code. Prefer failing closed (raise 500) when CRON_SECRET is not configured.

settings/index.tsx line 893 uses hard-coded strings for the streak reminder label instead of the i18n helper used elsewhere — inconsistent with the rest of the Notifications list (which uses translation keys, though those keys are currently missing translations).
